title: CJP protest in Delhi LIVE: Govt reaches out to CJP team for talks; lathi-charge reported as students march towards Jantar Mantar
summary: Delhi Metro has announced the closure of Janpath, Rajiv Chowk, Patel Chowk, Central Secretariat and Seva Teerth metro stations, ahead of the Parliament march, due to ‘security reasons’.

title: Monsoon session of Parliament LIVE: Both Houses adjourn briefly; Kharge raises in question paper leaks, students protest in Rajya Sabha
summary: The Houses were adjourned till 12 p.m.; Opposition members resorted to sloganeering in the Lok Sabha demanding a discussion on various issues

title: What’s the agenda for the Monsoon session | Explained
summary: The government has listed five new Bills for the Monsoon Session of Parliament; The government has neither formally confirmed nor denied reports that it may bring back a revised version of the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill during the Monsoon Session

title: Six killed as truck collides with car on Samruddhi Expressway in Maharashtra's Wardha
summary: The two vehicles caught fire after the accident; four car passengers and two occupants of the truck, including its driver, died in the accident

title: Kerala Health Minister K. Muraleedharan alleges vested interests behind row over food packet distribution at MCH
summary: Rejecting allegations that govt had banned distribution of food packets at hospitals, Minister clarifies that the decision is confined to Alappuzha MCH and is aimed at removing encroachment on govt land

title: PM Modi says he hopes ‘monsoon and Monsoon Session are productive’
summary: The Prime Minister said reforms initiated by his government “have given courage to youth to dare to take commendable steps”

title: Vilathikulam DMK MLA arrested for remarks against T.N. CM Vijay
summary: In a post on X, the DMK’s deputy general secretary Kanimozhi Karunanidhi strongly condemned the TVK government’s action on the MLA and termed it “high-handed”

title: Sonam Wangchuk hunger strike: Delhi HC agrees to hear wife Gitanjali Angmo’s plea challenging order to retain him in Safdarjung Hospital
summary: Gitanjali J. Angmo’s appeal said that the order does not address "informed consent" or one's right to accept or reject any medical treatment
